theorems.name: Submission.polyhedral_approx_open_truncation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ k : ℕ, θ x = k) → CompactlyContainedOpen V U → ∃ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity X ∧ X.mass < ∞ ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n, X ω = tauAction n (M ∩ V) θ ξ ω
